name: Common Lisp
needs: SBCL 2.0 or newer (uses SBCL-specific `sb-alien`) and nasm and ld (Linux x86-64) or as and ld (Linux ARM64)
notes: Written for SBCL. Other Lisps need their own FFI layer (for example CFFI) and a small change.
`read-peep` returns at most 4096 frames per call.
files: decodes the test files and prints checksums
